Milford Oyster Festival Returns August 14–15 for a Two‑Night Summer Celebration

Listed in 203local
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:49
Instaread

The Milford Oyster Festival is back at Fowler Field for two nights of live music, fresh oysters, and summertime fun. Happening Friday, August 14 (5–10 PM) and Saturday, August 15 (4–10 PM), this year’s festival is proudly presented by Xfinity and continues Milford’s tradition dating back to 1975. With thousands of visitors expected and a full weekend of food, music, and amusements, this is one of Connecticut’s most iconic summer events.

30,000 Locally Sourced Oysters + Endless Food & Drinks

More than 30,000 oysters will be served throughout the weekend, all locally sourced from Milford’s own Briarpatch Shellfish Company and Pearl’s Shellfish Farm. These oysters come straight from the Long Island Sound waters off Milford’s coast, a region known for its rich oystering history. Alongside the oysters, festival‑goers can enjoy a wide selection of food trucks, beer, wine, and hard seltzers.

Six Bands Across Two Nights

The 2026 music lineup brings major talent to Fowler Field. Friday, August 14 features: • School of Rock, Milford — 5:30 PM • Nashville Drive — 6:30 PM Saturday, August 15 features: • Two Of A Kind — 4:00 PM • Always Morning — 5:30 PM • The Stevie Experience Tribute — 6:30 PM • Mike DelGuidice — 8:30 PM Nashville Drive brings high‑energy country‑rock, while Mike DelGuidice — a longtime member of Billy Joel’s band — headlines Saturday with a powerhouse classic rock performance.

Amusements All Weekend Long

The festival offers amusement rides on Friday from 5–10 PM and Saturday from noon to 10 PM, making it a perfect family outing. Carnival games, rides, and classic festival entertainment fill Fowler Field all weekend long.

A Festival Powered by Volunteers & Community Giving

The Milford Oyster Festival is run entirely by volunteers, and each year the event gives back to local charities, strengthening the community while celebrating Milford’s coastal heritage. It’s a festival built by locals, for locals — and one that continues to grow thanks to community support.

Event Details

Dates: Friday, August 14 (5–10 PM) & Saturday, August 15 (4–10 PM) Location: Fowler Field, Milford Admission: $8 per night; kids 13 & under free with an adult

The 203local Take

For Fairfield and New Haven County residents, the Milford Oyster Festival is one of the best summer events within easy reach. It’s affordable, packed with incredible food, live music, and family fun — and it celebrates the coastal culture that makes living in the 203 so special. Whether you’re heading over for oysters, catching Mike DelGuidice live, or bringing the kids for a full day of amusements, this festival is a perfect way to soak up summer and support a community‑driven event that gives back year after year.
